title: dryopteris prismatica
intro: Dryopteris prismatica, commonly known as the Prickly Shield Fern, is a species of fern native to the tropical forests of Central and South America. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include its ability to reduce inflammation, lower blood pressure, and act as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Dryopteris prismatica include its potential as an anti-inflammatory agent, antimicrobial agent, and antispasmodic. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
